cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
get_filename_component(CSE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CSE_ROOT}/cmake/PlatformDefaults.cmake")
project(CseThirdPartyFixture LANGUAGES C CXX)
include("${CSE_ROOT}/cmake/TargetPlatform.cmake")
include("${CSE_ROOT}/cmake/NativeThirdParty.cmake")
cse_load_native_third_party()
add_executable(cse_third_party_fixture dependency_tests.cpp)
target_compile_features(cse_third_party_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(cse_third_party_fixture PRIVATE cse_native_media)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(cse_third_party_fixture PRIVATE /W4 /WX /EHsc)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME third-party COMMAND cse_third_party_fixture)
